headline: LeviLauncher v1.5.26
summary: Added customizable mod menu and inbuilt mod keybinds, animated GIF backgrounds, improved mod menu scroll restoration, and fixes for PojavControls and Hotbar Slot icons.

items.text: Added a configurable keyboard shortcut for the mod menu, with M as the default key.
Added animated GIF background support for the launcher.
Added keybind management for inbuilt mods.
The mod menu now restores your previous section and scroll position when reopened, in both compact and full modes.
Fixed Hotbar Slot item icon rendering.
